Name: Katu's Tilesheets (Bridges and Leaf Borders)
Author: HeyKatu
Description:
This is a [b]resource for map-makers[/b], and will not affect your game if you [b]don't have a mod which requires it[/b].

I was very frustrated with the lack of cute bridges, so I took the island bridges, made them a little more detailed, and recolored them. They are seasonal, so they'll have snow on them in the winter. I also made the questionable decision of baking shadows into my farm map, so they come with shadows.

These tilesheets also include two little stepping stones (to be animated), which are also seasonal.

Finally, there's a seasonal version of the leaf border that the Forest farm uses. This contains config options to have Spring colors be either Pink or Green, and to have Fall colors be either Green or Orange.

None of these are a replacer for vanilla! Just another option based on vanilla tiles. They are also designed to fit with recolors such as DaisyNiko's or Vibrant Pastoral.

Downloads.Description:
This file contains both the bridges and the leaf borders, and has a manifest.json and content.json so you can use it as a dependency.

Changelog: Users can now choose which color spring and fall leaves they have via GMCM.
